notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 zero-dimensional regional-interaction boundary. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It establishes ordinary default-region interaction delivery, then creates and commits an explicit region with no dimensions and verifies that Send Interaction With Regions does not overlap the ordinary subscription. No provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador interaction publication, ordinary subscription, zero-dimensional region creation and commit, ordinary and regional interaction send, region cleanup, and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador zero-dimensional regional interaction declarations
